attributes.action: Introduce a Shared Financial Consequences Principle for MPs
attributes.additional_details: Decision-makers should experience the same personal financial consequences of government policy as the people required to bear them. Accountability is weakened when public funding insulates MPs from ordinary costs affected by their decisions. A Shared Financial Consequences Principle would ensure MPs have a direct financial stake in the real-world impact of their decisions, while protecting legitimate additional costs of parliamentary duties.
attributes.background: Amend Parliamentary Standards Act to require IPSA apply a Shared Financial Consequences Principle so MPs personally bear ordinary taxes, household charges and living costs affected by their decisions, rather than being insulated by taxpayer funding, while protecting only genuine parliamentary costs

rejection.details:
We find what you are seeking to do in this petition unclear - MPs are already required to pay personal taxes, for example.

You can find information about MPs pay and expenses in these House of Commons Library briefings: https://commonslibrary.parliament.uk/research-briefings/cbp-9546/
